instruction: You're in a hallway, facing a staircase. Turn left and walk down this hallway. Step up to the open door at the end of the hallway, but don't go in. This is a bedroom, for reference. Turn right and step into the flagstone entryway. Right across from you is a large opening into a living room with a maroon couch and navy colored rug. Take two steps up onto the rug. There is a coffee table in the middle of two couches. Jump over the coffee table and stand in front of the fireplace. Once you're in front of the fireplace, turn right and walk into the dining room. There is an open door in the far right of the dining room. Go in that door. It leads to the kitchen. Once you're in the kitchen, you will walk to the end of the cabinet, keeping the sink on your left. You will walk toward the green breakfast table, again keeping that kitchen counter on your left. Then take a step up to the double doors on the left. Now you'll be looking into another living room. There's a tan couch in front of you with a small, brown side table. Step up toward that couch- I'm sorry that was actually a step up onto the first stair of the staircase. Now, look into the living room, so you're facing the TV on the desk in the corner. Step up to that TV and then take a right and stand between the windows with the brown shutters and the tan couch right in front of you with the blue pillows closest to you and a green one away from you. Now jump over this couch to stand at the far end between the couch and the window, by the white bookshelves. You are done.
